lines.text: Moses asks his father-in-law Jethro to let him return to Egypt, and Jethro says, "Go in peace."
Moses puts his wife and sons on a donkey and heads for Egypt with the staff of God.
The LORD tells Moses to perform the wonders before Pharaoh, and says He will harden Pharaoh's heart and call Israel His firstborn son.

wrong_details.wrong: Moses is told to perform the wonders before Pharaoh and the LORD says He will harden Pharaoh's heart, but the line says the LORD will take away Pharaoh's throne
wrong_details.true: The LORD says He will kill Pharaoh's firstborn son

lines.text: At a lodging place the LORD is about to kill Moses, but his brother Aaron circumcises his son and the LORD lets him alone.
Aaron meets Moses at the mountain of God, relays the LORD's words to the elders, and the people believe and worship.
